description: This Java source file defines the AnimationSeeking activity, which demonstrates the seeking capabilities of ValueAnimator in Android. It includes a custom View (MyAnimationView) that manages animated balls and a seek bar to control animation progress.

classes.name: AnimationSeeking
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating animation seeking with a custom view and seek bar.

classes.name: MyAnimationView
classes.description: Inner class extending View that handles drawing animated balls and controlling the animation state.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and assigns event listeners.

methods.name: createAnimation
methods.description: Sets up the bounce animation for the ball.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks the animation to a specific point based on the seek bar progress.

methods.name: addBall
methods.description: Creates and adds a new ball ShapeHolder with random color.

methods.name: onAnimationUpdate
methods.description: Callback to handle animation frame updates; triggers view redraw.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the animated ball on the canvas.
